# Dependency license supplement

The npm archive for `@nodable/entities` 3.1.0 declares MIT but omits the license file. The build includes the upstream license from the package's declared repository:

https://github.com/nodable/val-parsers/blob/main/LICENSE

Retrieved on 2026-10-09 and retained in `licenses/nodable-entities-LICENSE`. This file is copied into each portable skill with the other dependency licenses.
